title: Excluding paths and bicliques
summary: Classes of graphs excluding a path and a biclique as induced subgraphs are extensively studied in the literature. One of the key structural results for such graphs is a Ramsey-type result due to Galvin, Rival, and Sands (1982), establishing the existence of a function $f$ bounding the maximum length of a path in terms of clique number $ω$. We improve the best known bound on $f$ to a function that is a singly exponential in $ω^c$, for some constant $c$, which we show is best possible, up to optimizing $c$.
